question: Among Formula 1 drivers who raced during the 1950s, which drivers completed a season in that decade with the same constructor in both the first and the last race they participated in, while also taking part in at least two distinct race rounds during that season?
sql:
-- Final result: all distinct drivers who meet the criteria
WITH driver_races AS (
    SELECT r.year, dr.driver_id, r.round, dr.constructor_id,
           MIN(r.round) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, dr.driver_id) as min_round,
           MAX(r.round) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, dr.driver_id) as max_round
    FROM results dr
    JOIN races r ON dr.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
),
first_last AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT year, driver_id, min_round, max_round,
           FIRST_VALUE(constructor_id) OVER (PARTITION BY year, driver_id ORDER BY round) as first_constructor,
           FIRST_VALUE(constructor_id) OVER (PARTITION BY year, driver_id ORDER BY round DESC) as last_constructor
    FROM driver_races
),
rounds_count AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, COUNT(DISTINCT round) as num_rounds
    FROM driver_races
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT fl.year, fl.driver_id
    FROM first_last fl
    JOIN rounds_count rc ON fl.year = rc.year AND fl.driver_id = rc.driver_id
    WHERE fl.first_constructor = fl.last_constructor
      AND rc.num_rounds >= 2
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname as driver_name
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.driver_id = d.driver_id
ORDER BY d.surname, d.forename
